evidence.reason: The ledger accepts manual/agent report producers as evidence, but `validate()` requires every `outcome == "completed"` review to pass `creditable()`, which only recognizes vendor producers (`crq-runner-app` / `coderabbitai[bot]`). The nearby comment states manual/agent completions cannot earn vendor credit, not that they must be rejected, so valid completed manual/agent reports fail ingestion despite passing `validate_provenance` and scope checks. Narrowing the credit check to non-report producers is the smallest compatible repair.
